layers.description: 纯 C# 定义、权威运行时状态、规则与端口，不依赖 Unity 或框架运行时。
layers.descriptionEn: Pure C# definitions, authoritative runtime state, rules, and ports without Unity or framework-runtime dependencies.

layers.description: 负责组合、协议转换、SO/坐标映射、异步流程、持久化和框架接入。
layers.descriptionEn: Owns composition, protocol translation, ScriptableObject and coordinate mapping, asynchronous flows, persistence, and framework integration.

layers.description: 负责输入、动画、3D 与 UI 表现，只通过查询和命令接入玩法能力。
layers.descriptionEn: Owns input, animation, 3D, and UI presentation and accesses gameplay through queries and commands.

entries.description: Unity 异步/await 集成包。
entries.descriptionEn: Async/await integration package for Unity.

entries.description: ZFramework 资源包初始化、更新、下载与加载的底层资源管理包。
entries.descriptionEn: Underlying asset package used by ZFramework for initialization, updates, downloads, and loading.
constraints: 资源流程由 ZFramework 的 IResourceModule 与启动 Procedure 封装
constraintsEn: Asset workflows are wrapped by ZFramework IResourceModule and startup Procedures

entries.description: ZFramework 运行时模块的注册、获取、更新和关闭组合根。
entries.descriptionEn: Composition root for registering, resolving, updating, and shutting down ZFramework runtime modules.
entries.usageNotes: 业务代码获取已注册模块时优先使用 GameModule 缓存入口；仅组合根、启动注册和框架扩展代码直接调用 ModuleSystem.GetModule/RegisterModule。让 ModuleSystem 统一驱动 Update 与 Shutdown，不要建立平行模块容器。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use the cached GameModule entry points when game code resolves registered modules. Call ModuleSystem.GetModule/RegisterModule directly only from composition roots, startup registration, or framework extensions; let ModuleSystem own Update and Shutdown instead of creating a parallel module container.
constraints: 业务层优先通过 GameModule 缓存入口访问；组合根与启动注册代码可以直接使用 ModuleSystem
constraintsEn: Game code should use cached GameModule access; composition roots and startup registration may use ModuleSystem directly

entries.description: 基于 YooAsset 的资源包初始化、版本/清单更新、资源加载和引用释放模块。
entries.descriptionEn: YooAsset-based module for package initialization, version and manifest updates, asset loading, and reference release.
entries.usageNotes: 运行时资产统一通过 GameModule.Resource 访问；普通资产优先异步加载，GameObject 使用 LoadGameObjectAsync，并为非默认内容包显式传入 packageName。把取消令牌绑定到调用方生命周期，手动加载的 Asset 必须配对 UnloadAsset，实例与句柄也要按所有权及时释放。
entries.usageNotesEn: Route runtime assets through GameModule.Resource. Prefer asynchronous loading for ordinary assets, use LoadGameObjectAsync for GameObjects, and pass packageName explicitly for non-default content packages. Bind cancellation to the caller lifecycle and release manually loaded assets, instances, and handles according to ownership.
capabilities: 多运行模式资源初始化
constraints: LoadAssetAsync 必须配对释放
GameObject 优先使用 LoadGameObjectAsync
业务层通过 GameModule.Resource 访问
constraintsEn: LoadAssetAsync must be paired with release
Prefer LoadGameObjectAsync for GameObjects
Game code accesses it through GameModule.Resource

entries.description: 通过类型接口和 string/int 事件 ID 解耦模块的事件派发能力。
entries.descriptionEn: Event dispatch capability that decouples modules through typed interfaces and string/int event IDs.
entries.usageNotes: 跨模块的一对多通知使用 GameEvent；固定公共契约优先类型接口事件，确需动态路由时才使用稳定的 string/int ID。UI 内使用 AddUIEvent 让订阅随界面释放，其他订阅必须以同一委托显式移除；不要用事件总线代替请求返回或共享状态。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use GameEvent for one-to-many notifications across modules. Prefer typed interface events for stable public contracts and use stable string/int IDs only when dynamic routing is necessary. Inside UI code use AddUIEvent for lifecycle cleanup; elsewhere remove the same delegate explicitly, and do not use the event bus as request/response or shared state.
capabilities: UI 生命周期事件绑定
constraints: 模块间使用 GameEvent
UI 内部事件使用 AddUIEvent 并随生命周期清理
constraintsEn: Use GameEvent between modules
Use AddUIEvent inside UI and clean it up with the UI lifecycle

entries.description: 面向实现 IMemory 的纯 C# 对象复用与回收能力。
entries.descriptionEn: Reusable allocation and recycling for pure C# objects implementing IMemory.
entries.usageNotes: 只为高频、短生命周期且实现 IMemory 的纯 C# 对象使用 MemoryPool。获取后明确单一所有者，并在 finally 或等价清理路径中 Release；归还前清空可变状态，归还后不得访问或重复归还。长生命周期对象和 UnityEngine.Object 不使用该池。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use MemoryPool only for frequently allocated, short-lived pure C# objects that implement IMemory. Give each acquired object one clear owner and Release it from a finally block or equivalent cleanup path; reset mutable state before return and never access or release it twice afterward. Do not use this pool for long-lived objects or UnityEngine.Object instances.
constraints: Release 后不得继续访问对象
同一对象不得重复 Release
constraintsEn: Objects must not be accessed after Release
The same object must not be released twice

entries.description: 管理 Unity 游戏对象与自定义对象池实例、更新和释放的运行时模块。
entries.descriptionEn: Runtime module that manages creation, updates, and release of Unity and custom object pools.
entries.usageNotes: 对需要重复 Spawn/Unspawn 的 Unity 对象或 ObjectBase 对象使用 IObjectPoolModule；在组合根创建并复用命名池，按峰值设置容量与过期时间。归还前重置可变状态，场景或功能卸载时销毁对应池；低频且廉价的对象无需池化。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use IObjectPoolModule for Unity or ObjectBase instances that repeatedly Spawn and Unspawn. Create and reuse named pools at the composition root, sizing capacity and expiration for peak demand. Reset mutable state before return and destroy the relevant pool when its scene or feature unloads; do not pool cheap, infrequently created objects.
constraints: 对象归还后不得继续持有可变状态
constraintsEn: Mutable state must not be retained after an object is returned

entries.description: 纯 C# UIWindow/UIWidget 生命周期、层级、资源与事件协作框架。
entries.descriptionEn: Pure C# framework coordinating UIWindow/UIWidget lifecycles, layers, assets, and events.
entries.usageNotes: 完整界面继承 UIWindow，可复用局部继承 UIWidget，并统一通过 GameModule.UI 打开、关闭和查询。异步加载的取消与资源释放必须绑定窗口生命周期，界面事件使用 AddUIEvent；不要在业务代码中直接 Instantiate 窗口或长期持有已关闭界面引用。
entries.usageNotesEn: Derive full screens from UIWindow and reusable regions from UIWidget, then open, close, and query them through GameModule.UI. Tie asynchronous cancellation and resource release to the window lifecycle and register UI events through AddUIEvent; do not instantiate windows directly in game code or retain references after closure.
capabilities: UI 层级与全屏窗口管理
capabilitiesEn: UI layers and full-screen window management
constraints: 通过 GameModule.UI 访问
窗口资源和事件必须随生命周期释放
constraintsEn: Access through GameModule.UI
Window assets and events must be released with the lifecycle

entries.description: Luban 生成配置的同步、异步与懒加载接入边界。当前检出未包含 GameProto、LubanLib 或 ConfigSystem 生成输出。
entries.descriptionEn: Integration boundary for synchronous, asynchronous, and lazy loading of Luban-generated configuration. This checkout does not contain GameProto, LubanLib, or generated ConfigSystem output.
entries.usageNotes: 仅在 ConfigSystem 与 GameConfig 生成输出存在后使用该能力，并把生成入口作为配置查询的唯一边界。启动必需表可异步预加载，非关键表按需懒加载；二进制配置通过 ResourceModule 和明确的 packageName 读取。不得手改生成代码，输出缺失时应重新生成而不是另建并行解析器。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use this capability only after the generated ConfigSystem and GameConfig output exists, and treat the generated entry point as the sole configuration-query boundary. Asynchronously preload startup-critical tables and lazily load optional ones; read binary data through ResourceModule with an explicit packageName. Never hand-edit generated code, and regenerate missing output instead of building a parallel parser.
capabilities: Luban 表结构与代码生成
constraints: 当前代码核验状态为 partial：使用前必须先生成或恢复 ConfigSystem 与 GameConfig 输出
生成代码属于普通 Player 程序集
constraintsEn: Verified as partial: generate or restore ConfigSystem and GameConfig output before use
Generated code belongs to ordinary Player assemblies

entries.description: 按 owner 类型与可选名称创建、获取、更新和销毁多个相互独立的有限状态机。
entries.descriptionEn: Creates, resolves, updates, and destroys multiple independent finite-state machines keyed by owner type and optional name.
entries.usageNotes: 用于互斥状态及明确的进入、更新、离开转换；通过 IFsmModule.CreateFsm 创建，并以 owner 类型与稳定名称区分同类状态机，所属组合根在退出时 DestroyFsm。游戏大阶段可建立独立 FSM；并行系统、一次性命令、数值结算和广播通知不要建模为状态。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use it for mutually exclusive states with explicit enter, update, and leave transitions. Create machines through IFsmModule.CreateFsm, distinguish machines of the same owner type with stable names, and let the owning composition root call DestroyFsm during teardown. A game-phase machine may be independent; do not model parallel systems, one-shot commands, numeric resolution, or broadcast notifications as states.
capabilities: 按 owner 与名称查询
constraints: 同一 owner 类型与名称的组合必须唯一
状态机所有者负责在生命周期结束时销毁实例
constraintsEn: Each owner-type and name pair must be unique
The FSM owner must destroy the instance when its lifecycle ends

entries.description: 基于 FSM 的启动流程注册、切换与逐帧生命周期模块。
entries.descriptionEn: FSM-based module for startup procedure registration, transitions, and per-frame lifecycle execution.
entries.usageNotes: 用于互斥、粗粒度且具有明确 Enter/Update/Leave 生命周期的流程状态；在组合根注册完整 Procedure 集合，并通过 GameModule.Procedure 启动和切换。状态只负责阶段编排与交接，不用于并行子系统、短暂 UI 导航或通用事件广播；启动顺序遵循 zframework-startup-lifecycle。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use ProcedureModule for mutually exclusive, coarse-grained states with explicit Enter/Update/Leave lifecycles. Register the complete Procedure set at the composition root and start or transition through GameModule.Procedure. Keep states focused on stage orchestration and handoff, not parallel subsystems, transient UI navigation, or general event broadcasting; follow zframework-startup-lifecycle for startup ordering.
capabilities: 进入/更新/离开生命周期
constraints: 可复用启动顺序由 tengine-startup-lifecycle Architecture 定义
constraintsEn: The reusable startup sequence is defined by the tengine-startup-lifecycle Architecture

entries.description: 从组合根初始化框架模块，经可替换的 Procedure 状态链完成资源准备，再进入业务扩展点的可复用启动生命周期。具体项目 UI、内容包和 GameApp 逻辑不是该架构契约的一部分。
entries.descriptionEn: Reusable startup lifecycle that initializes framework modules at the composition root, prepares assets through replaceable Procedure states, and enters a game extension point. Project UI, content packages, and GameApp logic are outside this architecture contract.
entries.usageNotes: 用于从框架模块初始化、资源准备推进到业务扩展点的完整启动生命周期；由组合根注册和启动 Procedure，项目 UI、内容包名称与具体 GameApp 交接写入独立 System。玩法系统不得跳过阶段前置条件或直接推进启动 Procedure。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use this lifecycle to move from framework-module initialization and asset preparation to a game extension point. The composition root registers and starts Procedures, while project UI, package names, and concrete GameApp handoff belong in a separate System. Gameplay systems must not skip stage prerequisites or advance startup Procedures directly.
constraints: Architecture 阶段只定义顺序与扩展点，不固化项目 UI 文案、内容包名称或具体 GameApp 行为
联机资源模式需完成清单与下载流程后进入内容包阶段
constraintsEn: Architecture stages define ordering and extension points without fixing project UI text, package names, or concrete GameApp behavior
Online asset modes complete manifest and download stages before content package initialization

entries.description: 当前项目把 Launcher UI、更新设置、内容包流程和 GameApp 业务入口接入通用启动生命周期的组合实现。
entries.descriptionEn: Project-specific composition that connects Launcher UI, update settings, content-package flow, and the GameApp entry point to the reusable startup lifecycle.
entries.usageNotes: 项目启动、资源更新或内容包准备完成后进入业务时使用 ProcedureInitResources、ProcedureInitContentPackages、ProcedureStartGame 与 GameApp.Entrance 这一条接入链；玩法系统不要直接推进启动 Procedure，首个业务入口之外也不要重复调用 GameApp.Entrance。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use the ProcedureInitResources, ProcedureInitContentPackages, ProcedureStartGame, and GameApp.Entrance integration chain during project startup, asset updates, content-package preparation, and the final handoff into game code. Gameplay systems must not advance startup Procedures directly or invoke GameApp.Entrance again after the initial handoff.
constraints: 项目 UI 文案、包名称和首个业务界面只属于该项目接入，不得写入通用启动生命周期契约
GameApp.Entrance 只在 ProcedureStartGame 进入后调用
constraintsEn: Project UI text, package names, and the first game screen belong to this integration and must not enter the reusable lifecycle contract
GameApp.Entrance is invoked only after entering ProcedureStartGame

entries.description: 为需要确定性模拟的玩法系统提供可注入随机源和领域事件输出端口。
entries.descriptionEn: Provides injectable randomness and a domain-event output port for gameplay systems that require deterministic simulation.
entries.usageNotes: 规则需要随机抽取或向外报告领域结果时使用 IRandomSource / IDomainEventSink；正式运行由 Adapter 注入实现，测试注入固定序列或 seed。不要在 GameCore 内调用 UnityEngine.Random 或直接发布 GameEvent。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use IRandomSource or IDomainEventSink when rules need random selection or must report domain outcomes. Adapters inject production implementations, while tests inject fixed sequences or seeds. Do not call UnityEngine.Random or publish GameEvent directly from GameCore.
constraints: asmdef 必须保持 noEngineReferences
不得引用 TEngine、Unity、SO、UniTask 或 GameEvent
constraintsEn: The asmdef must keep noEngineReferences
Must not reference TEngine, Unity, ScriptableObjects, UniTask, or GameEvent

entries.description: 用独立 ZFramework FSM 编排营地、狩猎和 Boss 战三个互斥游戏阶段。
entries.descriptionEn: Uses an independent ZFramework FSM to orchestrate the mutually exclusive Settlement, Hunt, and Boss Fight phases.
entries.usageNotes: GameManager 完成各阶段依赖装配后调用 PhaseManager.Start；阶段出口统一调用 TransitionTo，退出游戏或重建组合根时调用 Shutdown。它只负责阶段转换，不负责战斗、地图或营地内部结算。
entries.usageNotesEn: After GameManager composes phase dependencies, call PhaseManager.Start. Route phase exits through TransitionTo and call Shutdown when the game or composition root is torn down. This system owns phase transitions, not combat, map, or settlement resolution.
constraints: 状态仅编排阶段，不承载各阶段玩法数据
与启动 Procedure 使用不同 FSM 实例
constraintsEn: States orchestrate phases and do not own phase gameplay data
Uses an FSM instance separate from startup Procedures

entries.description: 负责角色与 Boss 攻击管线、部位抽取与结算、回合门禁及时点规则。
entries.descriptionEn: Owns hunter and Boss attack pipelines, hit-location draw and resolution, turn gates, and timeline rules.
entries.usageNotes: 开始攻击或推进战斗回合时使用 CombatManager、CombatTurnFlow 和 TimelineManager；GameCore 先确定规则结果，Adapter 等待输入/动画并发布完成事件，View 只实现 IPlayerInputProvider 与表现。不要从 View 直接扣血或绕过 AttackPipeline。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use CombatManager, CombatTurnFlow, and TimelineManager when starting attacks or advancing combat turns. GameCore determines rule outcomes, Adapters await input and animation and publish completion events, and Views only implement IPlayerInputProvider and presentation. Do not mutate health from Views or bypass AttackPipeline.
capabilities: Boss 部位抽取与效果结算
capabilitiesEn: Boss hit-location draw and effect resolution
constraints: 异步入口必须被顺序等待
规则状态属于 GameCore，输入与动画属于 Adapter/View
constraintsEn: Asynchronous entry points must be awaited sequentially
Rule state belongs to GameCore while input and animation belong to Adapter/View

entries.description: 管理六边形场地拓扑、全部场上实体的占位与朝向、地形查询、移动和击退计划。
entries.descriptionEn: Manages hex topology, occupancy and facing for all battlefield entities, terrain queries, movement, and knockback plans.
entries.usageNotes: 查询或修改场上实体时通过 IBoardQuery / IBoardCommand 和 BoardManager；规则使用 GridPosition，Adapter 负责 Vector2Int/Vector3 转换。击退先由 KnockbackService.Plan 生成路径，View 播放后再 TryCommit。不要让可视化对象成为占位权威。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use IBoardQuery, IBoardCommand, and BoardManager to query or mutate battlefield entities. Rules use GridPosition while Adapters translate Vector2Int and Vector3. Plan knockback with KnockbackService.Plan, let the View animate it, then TryCommit. Visual objects must not become occupancy authority.
constraints: GameCore 不使用 Unity 坐标
移动与伤害提交不得早于表现完成
constraintsEn: GameCore does not use Unity coordinates
Movement and damage must not commit before presentation completes

entries.displayName: 行动牌费用与战斗行动环境
entries.displayNameEn: Action Card Costs and Combat Action Environment
entries.description: 负责行动牌朝向、费用事务，以及 ScriptableObject 卡牌效果到战斗 GameAction 的映射。
entries.descriptionEn: Owns action-card orientation, cost transactions, and mapping ScriptableObject card effects to combat GameActions.
entries.usageNotes: 出牌、恢复、爆发、回合与 Boss 行动等玩法命令统一交给 PlayableCombatSession，并由 PlayableCombatActionSession 的 Combat ActionEnvironment 执行 Root/Child GameAction。表现等待可作为玩法 Action 的呈现边界，但纯 UI 事件不得进入 ActionQueue。CharacterActionCardInstance 负责把 SO 配置映射为运行时定义。
entries.usageNotesEn: Send gameplay commands such as play, restore, burst, turns, and boss actions through PlayableCombatSession; PlayableCombatActionSession executes their root/child GameActions in the Combat ActionEnvironment. Presentation waits may be gameplay-action boundaries, but UI-only events must not enter ActionQueue. CharacterActionCardInstance maps ScriptableObject configuration to runtime definitions.
capabilities: SO 到运行时卡牌映射
constraints: 权威玩法效果必须走 Combat ActionEnvironment
纯 UI 事件不得进入 ActionQueue
卡牌交互表现不拥有玩法状态
constraintsEn: Authoritative gameplay effects must use the Combat ActionEnvironment
UI-only events must not enter ActionQueue
Card interaction presentation does not own gameplay state

entries.description: 负责四部位生命与护甲、致命伤死亡牌堆和永久损伤扩展口。
entries.descriptionEn: Owns four-part health and armor, the fatal-wound death deck, and the permanent-injury extension port.
entries.usageNotes: 角色受伤、护甲减伤或判定死亡时使用 HunterInjuryState；Combat Adapter 将结果翻译为事件和 UI 查询模型。每名运行时猎人必须持有独立状态，不要修改共享 SO，也不要用旧 TemporaryWounds 阈值代替权威状态。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use HunterInjuryState for damage, armor mitigation, and death checks. Combat Adapters translate outcomes to events and UI query models. Each runtime hunter must own an independent state; do not mutate shared ScriptableObjects or replace authority with the legacy TemporaryWounds threshold.
constraints: 不得共享可变伤势状态
旧伤口字段只用于兼容显示和序列化
constraintsEn: Mutable injury state must not be shared
Legacy wound fields are only for display and serialization compatibility

entries.description: 协调年份推进、事件、发明、制造、设施值守、猎人管理与狩猎出发。
entries.descriptionEn: Coordinates year advancement, events, invention, crafting, facility duty, hunter management, and departure for hunts.
entries.usageNotes: 进入营地、推进年份、制造、设施值守、招募或出发时通过 SettlementManager 聚合的阶段服务与对应 Action；规则状态归 SettlementInstance，View 只提交 ActionQueue 命令与显示回调。新增独立营地规则应进入对应服务或 Action，不继续扩张 SettlementManager。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use the phase services and matching Actions aggregated by SettlementManager when entering settlement, advancing years, crafting, assigning facility duty, recruiting, or departing. SettlementInstance owns rule state and Views only submit ActionQueue commands and display callbacks. Put new independent settlement rules in a matching service or Action instead of expanding SettlementManager.
constraints: SettlementManager 只协调子系统
SO 配置必须映射后再进入规则
constraintsEn: SettlementManager only coordinates subsystems
ScriptableObject configuration must be mapped before entering rules

entries.description: 协调狩猎地图生成、翻图与导航、资源采集、探索事件和 Boss 遭遇。
entries.descriptionEn: Coordinates hunt-map generation, reveal and navigation, resource gathering, exploration events, and Boss encounters.
entries.usageNotes: 进入狩猎、点击地图、采集或结束狩猎时通过 HuntManager；GameCore 提供地图/导航/资源规则，Adapter 映射 HexTileData 与 Vector2Int，View 负责世界地图和 HUD。不要让 HuntMapVisualizer 修改地图权威状态。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use HuntManager when entering a hunt, interacting with the map, gathering, or completing the hunt. GameCore provides map, navigation, and resource rules; Adapters map HexTileData and Vector2Int; Views own the world map and HUD. HuntMapVisualizer must not mutate authoritative map state.
capabilities: 探索事件与 Boss 遭遇
constraints: 地图权威状态不在 View
Unity 坐标只在 Adapter/View
constraintsEn: Authoritative map state does not live in Views
Unity coordinates stay in Adapter/View

entries.description: 把营地运行时数据映射为 JsonUtility 存档，常规保存在线程池执行，并在应用退出时同步刷新最新快照。
entries.descriptionEn: Maps settlement runtime data to JsonUtility saves, writes ordinary saves on a thread pool, and synchronously flushes the latest snapshot when the application exits.
entries.usageNotes: 保存、读取、检查或删除项目存档时使用 SaveLoadSystem，常规异步调用把 CancellationToken 绑定到所有者生命周期；只有应用退出回调使用 SaveImmediate 刷新最新快照。读取完成后由 SettlementManager.InjectData 重绑子系统。它是 Adapter，不是 GameCore 规则，也不是 TEngine 的通用存档模块。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use SaveLoadSystem to save, load, inspect, or delete project saves and bind ordinary asynchronous calls to the owner's CancellationToken. Use SaveImmediate only from the application-exit callback to flush the latest snapshot. After loading, SettlementManager.InjectData rebinds subsystems. This is an Adapter, not a GameCore rule or a generic TEngine save module.
constraints: NonSerialized 引用不会自动恢复
JsonUtility 反序列化必须切回主线程
constraintsEn: NonSerialized references are not restored automatically
JsonUtility deserialization must return to the main thread

entries.description: 保留旧 EventBus 调用面，并把跨模块玩法通知委托给 ZFramework GameEvent。
entries.descriptionEn: Preserves the legacy EventBus call surface while delegating cross-module gameplay notifications to ZFramework GameEvent.
entries.usageNotes: 现有玩法兼容代码可继续 Publish/Subscribe，新的跨模块通知优先使用稳定的 GameEvent 类型契约；请求返回和权威状态查询应直接调用接口。旧 EventBus 只能做代理，不得恢复独立监听表。
entries.usageNotesEn: Existing compatibility code may continue to Publish and Subscribe, while new cross-module notifications should prefer stable typed GameEvent contracts. Use direct interfaces for request/response and authoritative queries. The legacy EventBus remains a delegate and must not regain a separate listener store.
constraints: 事件不代替请求返回或共享状态
订阅必须按所有者生命周期清理
constraintsEn: Events do not replace request/response or shared state
Subscriptions must be cleaned up with owner lifecycles

entries.description: 项目内可复用的 3D 卡牌拖拽、槽位吸附、动态卡堆、可配置堆叠视觉和卡堆预览系统；当前仍引用项目 UI.EntityCreator，尚未达到跨项目 Architecture 边界。
entries.descriptionEn: Project-reusable system for 3D card dragging, slot snapping, dynamic stacks, configurable stack visuals, and stack previews. It still references the project UI.EntityCreator and has not yet reached a cross-project Architecture boundary.
entries.usageNotes: 制作新的 3D 卡牌时继承 CardView3D；用 CardSlot 配置类别、是否堆叠、容量、抽取目标和预览权限，用 SlotGrid 管理自动扩展槽位。玩法卡 View 只把交互结果转成 Adapter 命令，不直接修改 GameCore；创建 CardSlot 后必须在属性赋值完成时调用 Build。若项目无需 3D 世界空间卡牌则不使用本能力。
entries.usageNotesEn: Derive new 3D cards from CardView3D. Configure category, stacking, capacity, draw target, and preview permission through CardSlot, and use SlotGrid for auto-expanding slots. Gameplay card Views translate interaction outcomes into Adapter commands and do not mutate GameCore directly. Call Build after assigning CardSlot properties. Do not use this capability for projects without world-space 3D cards.
capabilities: 松散卡自动合并为动态卡堆
编辑器可配置槽位堆叠
随数量变化的卡堆高度与最多 8 层 ghost
按卡堆开关显示或隐藏内容预览
capabilitiesEn: Automatic loose-card merge into dynamic stacks
Count-driven stack height with up to eight ghost layers
Per-stack toggle for showing or hiding content previews
constraints: CardSlot 必须在配置完成后 Build
StackUp 的实际卡牌 Y 偏移尚未按视觉上限封顶，只有 ghost 数量封顶为 8
预览规则目前只有 Previewable 布尔开关，尚无可插拔策略接口
提取为 Architecture 前必须移除对 UI.EntityCreator.DefaultCardThickness 的项目依赖
constraintsEn: CardSlot must Build after configuration
Actual StackUp card Y offsets are not capped yet; only ghost count is capped at eight
Preview behavior currently has only the Previewable boolean and no pluggable strategy interface
Remove the project dependency on UI.EntityCreator.DefaultCardThickness before extracting this as Architecture
